risks.risk: It may not heat properly (weak heating element) or may cut out intermittently.
risks.proof: A short video of the iron plugged in and heating (showing temperature/indicator if present, and a quick test on fabric).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven working (worst case: treat as needing repair/uncertain heating).

risks.risk: Cord/plug damage or loose connection could cause sparking or failure under load.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the plug pins and cord entry + a video showing it operating without flicker/sparking.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible electrical issues (worst case: assume cord/plug may need replacement).

risks.risk: Soleplate condition may affect ironing quality (burn marks, uneven surface, poor glide).
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the soleplate surface (including the tip) in good light.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as cosmetically worn and potentially affecting performance (worst case: treat as average/used condition).

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, so compatibility and comparable pricing are uncertain.
risks.proof: Photo of the iron’s rating plate/label (underside or back) showing brand and model.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used dry iron (worst case: lowest comparable tier).

proof_requests: Photo of the rating plate/label showing brand and model (and voltage/wattage).
Video of the iron plugged in and heating properly (quick fabric test).
Close-up photos of the plug pins and cord entry for damage.
Photos of the receipt and warranty card (if available).
response.reason: From photo 0 the item is a dry pressing iron, but the key claim (that it is still working with no faults) is not verifiable remotely without a power-on test and the brand/model is not readable for accurate pricing.
